==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I appeared in the village via a destructive portal. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The portal resembled an electrified purple tornado. Traveling through the portal felt like sliding down a tingly slide and was a lot of fun. It felt like an ASMR water slide.) The portal accidentally damaged the shop/home of a gnome wizard who proceeded to attack me. (The gnome wizard resembles a short, brown skinned gnome, with pointed ears and a long bushy white beard, dressed in pink robes, with a matching pink cone shaped hat.) I appeased him by letting him live and teach at the Magic Hero Academy. (The Magic Hero Academy resembles three towers of white stone in a row, with the center tower being taller than the other two adjacent towers.) (The Magic Hero Academy Uniforms worn by the young adult elven students there resemble form fitting purple robes with a shiny golden trim.)
